name: task-4
_ambiguities: Storage is checked as substrings of localStorage 'data' (JSON with double quotes, as JSON.stringify writes). Key order, spacing and the survey-level title value are not pinned; the survey title is checked only as the presence of a 'title' key.

Only the Question properties from task 4 (className, title, name, preview) are checked. Config properties such as 'required' are checked in task 15 and the type-specific properties in their own tasks.
The value of 'preview' in saved design data is not pinned, only that the key exists.
The 'pv' actor checks that Preview saves before any Save click (a fresh browser, no prior Save). It does not check that the saved data reflects later edits.
Whether Preview opens the same tab reference or a new one is covered only by the switch_to_popup and a return to the design tab.
